github.title: GitHub App
github.description: Configure GitHub App OAuth credentials for sign-in, registration, and profile linking.
github.error.title: Could not load GitHub settings
github.form.section_hint: Use your GitHub App OAuth credentials. Login and registration can be enabled independently; global registration must also be on.
github.form.callback_hint: Set this callback URL in your GitHub App: {{url}}
github.form.enabled_hint: Requires Client ID and Client Secret.
github.form.register_enabled_hint: Also requires global registration to be enabled under Auth settings.
github.form.client_id_hint: OAuth client ID from the GitHub App.
github.form.client_secret_hint: Leave blank to keep the current secret.
github.form.private_key_hint: Stored encrypted for future GitHub API use. Leave blank to keep the current key.
google.title: Google
google.description: Configure Google OAuth for sign-in and registration.
google.error.title: Could not load Google settings
google.form.section_hint: Create OAuth credentials in Google Cloud Console. Redirect URI must end with /api/auth/callback/google.
google.form.login_enabled_hint: Requires Client ID and Client Secret.
google.form.register_enabled_hint: Also requires global registration under Auth settings.
google.form.client_secret_hint: Leave blank to keep the current secret.
facebook.title: Facebook
facebook.description: Configure Facebook Login for sign-in and registration.
facebook.error.title: Could not load Facebook settings
facebook.form.section_hint: Production apps cannot use localhost — use a Facebook development app for local callbacks.
facebook.form.login_enabled_hint: Requires App ID (Client ID) and App Secret.
facebook.form.register_enabled_hint: Also requires global registration under Auth settings.
facebook.form.client_id_hint: Facebook App ID used as OAuth client ID.
facebook.form.client_secret_hint: Leave blank to keep the current secret.
apple.title: Apple
apple.description: Configure Sign in with Apple. Client secret must be a JWT.
apple.error.title: Could not load Apple settings
apple.form.section_hint: Apple requires HTTPS (including local). Use a Services ID as Client ID and a generated JWT as the client secret.
apple.form.login_enabled_hint: Requires Services ID and client secret JWT.
apple.form.register_enabled_hint: Also requires global registration under Auth settings.
apple.form.client_secret_hint: Leave blank to keep the current secret. Generate via Apple key tooling.
whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Connect the single WhatsApp number (wuzapi) used for OTP codes, notifications and conversations.
whatsapp.error.title: Could not load WhatsApp status
whatsapp.not_configured: The WhatsApp gateway is not configured on the server (WUZAPI_URL / WUZAPI_ADMIN_TOKEN).
whatsapp.webhook_missing: WUZAPI_WEBHOOK_URL is empty: incoming messages and connection alarms will not reach the backend.
whatsapp.status.title: Connection
whatsapp.connect.title: Link a phone
whatsapp.connect.hint: Start the session, then scan the QR code in WhatsApp > Linked devices. The code refreshes every few seconds.
whatsapp.pair.title: Pair with phone number
whatsapp.pair.hint: Alternative to the QR code: enter the number and type the code in WhatsApp > Linked devices > Link with phone number.
whatsapp.logout_confirm: Log the WhatsApp session out? A new QR scan will be required.
whatsapp.test.title: Test message
whatsapp.settings.title: OTP settings
whatsapp.settings.sms_fallback_hint: When WhatsApp fails, send OTP codes by SMS.
whatsapp.settings.kvkk_hint: Appended to every OTP message in the recipient's language. Each change creates a new version; the version is stored with every code.
whatsapp.events.title: Connection history
glorian.title: Glorian integration
glorian.description: Hub connection of the Glorian brand: settings, sync runs, held order outbounds and the reconcile drift report.
glorian.forbidden: You do not have permission to view the Glorian integration.
glorian.read_only: Read only: changing the connection needs the Glorian manage permission.
glorian.not_configured: Save the connection first; sync runs, outbounds and reconcile appear once it exists.
glorian.error.title: Could not load the Glorian connection
glorian.connection.title: Connection
glorian.connection.description: Hub address, API key and default warehouse. The API key is write only and is never shown.
glorian.form.base_url_hint: http(s) root address of the Glorian hub.
glorian.form.api_key_hint: Stored encrypted. Required to activate the connection.
glorian.form.api_key_keep_hint: A key is stored. Leave blank to keep it or type a new one to replace it.
glorian.form.default_warehouse_hint: UUID of a warehouse of the brand center (optional).
glorian.form.active_hint: An inactive connection is not synced automatically.
glorian.validation.api_key_required: An API key is required to activate the connection.
glorian.errors.not_replayable: Only held or failed outbounds can be replayed.
glorian.errors.center_missing: The Glorian brand has no center organization.
glorian.errors.queue_unavailable: The task queue is unavailable; try again later.
glorian.errors.not_found: Not found. The connection may not be configured yet.
glorian.runs.title: Sync runs
glorian.runs.description: Pulls, barcode pushes, order outbounds and reconcile runs, newest first.
glorian.outbounds.title: Order outbounds
glorian.outbounds.description: Orders sent to the hub. Held and failed ones can be replayed.
glorian.held_reason.missing_customer_lin: The buyer is not linked to a hub dealer
glorian.reconcile.title: Reconcile
glorian.reconcile.description: Compares hub stock with local units and reports the drift. Read only: nothing is changed.
glorian.reconcile.running: Reconcile is running; the report appears when it finishes.
glorian.drift.none: No drift: hub and local stock match.
glorian.drift.hint.only_remote: Barcodes the hub lists but no local unit matches.
glorian.drift.hint.only_local: Hub-linked local units the hub no longer lists.
glorian.drift.hint.status_drift: The hub status differs from the local external status.
glorian.drift.hint.product_drift: The unit points to a different product on each side.
glorian.drift.hint.owner_drift: The hub location or dealer differs from the local owner.
